versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Adds automated multi-agent code review for pull requests, focusing on bugs, CLAUDE.md compliance, git history, and previous PR comments.
- Utilizes parallel agent architecture and confidence scoring to minimize false positives and avoid nitpicks.
- Only flags significant, verifiable issues; issues must score at least 80/100 confidence to be reported.
- Review process ignores pre-existing problems, stylistic nitpicks, and issues outside the scope of the modified code.
- Provides concise, well-linked GitHub PR comments with clear and actionable feedback.
